presentation_compatible_HL.reference: SAS-style approximation; formula also documented in statsmodels multivariate_stats

distribution_checks.reference: Independent Gaussian simulations at the actual n=48 and p=6; generated in R

partial_regression.interpretation: Explanatory adjustment uses recorded component labels; those labels never enter the diagnostic score

split.unit: valve x pump x accumulator setting
split.interpretation: Unseen nuisance settings within one rig and its three cooler phases; not future-machine validation

assumptions: Cooler and recording phase are perfectly confounded.
Classical p-values use independent Gaussian references; they do not identify causation.
Matched setting resampling retains pairing but cannot establish setting independence or remove drift.
Predictions concern one rig and its recorded conditions, not an externally validated machine fleet.
random_stream_note: All simulations are newly generated in R. R and the earlier implementation use different RNG streams; Monte Carlo p-values and intervals may therefore differ within simulation error.
